stories.headline: Forisk’s housing outlook points to fewer starts in 2027
stories.body: Forisk’s October 23 composite outlook projects 1.35 million U.S. housing starts in 2026 and 1.32 million in 2027, declines of 0.7% and 2%, respectively. The new 2027 estimate is 36,000 starts below its previous quarterly forecast.
